items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S6803

SPONSOR: KAPLAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act in relation to authorizing the department of labor to develop a
public awareness campaign promoting the New York state job bank

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

AN ACT in relation to authorizing the department of labor to develop a
public awareness campaign promoting the New York state job bank

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1 requires the department of labor to establish and implement a
public awareness campaign promoting the New York state job bank, as well
as any other related programs the commissioner deems appropriate. This
campaign shall include internet, radio, and print advertisement.
Further, this section also requires an annual report to the Governor and
the Legislature.

Section 2 is the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Currently the Department of Labor runs the New York State Jobs bank,
which helps connect employers and employees. This very good program does
an excellent job, but could benefit from some increased publicity so
that more employees and employers are made aware of its existence.
Related programs that currently exist are the NY Talent Bank, NY
Seasonal Works, and New York State Career Centers.  These programs bene-
fit all those involved, and could benefit from increased attention to
it. At the time of this bills introduction the Job Bank has over 130,000
job listings.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To Be Determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

BILL NUMBER: S6803A

SPONSOR: KAPLAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act in relation to authorizing the department of labor to develop a
public awareness campaign promoting the New York state job bank

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

To authorize the NYS Department of Labor to develop a public awareness
campaign promoting the New York State Job Bank.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 requires the Department of Labor to establish and implement a
public awareness campaign promoting the New York State Job Bank, as well
as any other related programs the Commissioner deems appropriate.

Provides the means by which the campaign can be made available to the
public.

Requires the Department of Labor to provide a report to the Governor and
the Legislature within one year after the effective date and annually
thereafter.

Section 2 sets the effective date.

 
DIFFERENCE BETWEEN ORIGINAL AND AMENDED VERSION (IF APPLICABLE):

Adds "newspapers" to the means by which the public awareness campaign
can be made available to the public.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Currently the Department of Labor runs the New York State Jobs bank,
which helps connect employers and employees. This very good program does
an excellent job, but could benefit from some increased publicity so
that more employees and employers are made aware of its existence.
Related programs that currently exist are the NY Talent Bank, NY
Seasonal Works, and New York State Career Centers. These programs bene-
fit all those involved, and could benefit from increased attention to
it. At the time of this bills introduction the Job Bank has over 130,000
job listings.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.
